finalText:
**Build is green again.** One real error, in `src/core/settings.js`.

The line `maxRetries: retries` used a name that was never declared, so the link step threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`. The comment right above it says the value should come from the caller with a constant fallback, so I made it read `env.retries` and added `DEFAULT_RETRIES = 3`.

`node build.js` now exits 0: `build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors`.

Those 3 warnings are separate from the break, and each is real:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| `W2213` unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| `W3307` circular import | `src/core/graph.js` <-> `src/state/tracker.js` |

Say the word and I'll clear them too.
